name: One Thing
intro: You will set One Thing up for yourself the way a new person does: pick a morning routine, add a task of your own, finish one thing and choose what to do next. Then we check it remembers everything, even with no internet.

steps.do: A white card at the bottom says “Welcome to One Thing”. Tap the small words “skip the tour” in its bottom-right corner. (Second try, or no white card? If a dark screen shows an orange “Show me how it works →” button, tap “I’ll explore on my own” instead and go straight to step 3.) (If you have opened One Thing on this phone before, you will not see the welcome: open the app, find the settings or “Erase my information” option, tap it and confirm, then open the link again. If you still don’t see the welcome, tick steps 1–5 as 🤷 and carry on.)
steps.see: The card changes to “You’re ready” with a dark “Let’s go ›” button.

steps.do: Tap “Let’s go ›”.
steps.see: A dark screen asks “Welcome! Who's first?” with a “Their name” box and two buttons, “🧒 Kid” and “🧑 Grown-up”.

steps.do: Tap the “Their name” box and type this name (keep the apostrophe):
steps.see: Margaret O'Brien shows in the box, apostrophe and all.

steps.do: Tap “🧑 Grown-up”. A “One Thing” title screen shows for a second or two — wait for it to go.
steps.see: A card asks “How much do you want to see?” with three choices: “🌱 Start simple”, “🌿 Routines and the week too” and “🌳 Show me everything”.

steps.do: Tap “🌱 Start simple”.
steps.see: A greeting (like “Good afternoon.”) and “What would you like to do?” with big choices: “🎯 Do my next thing”, “📝 Plan my day” and “🎬 Watch how it works”.

steps.do: Tap “📝 Plan my day”.
steps.see: The screen says “SETTING UP · 1 OF 4” with routine buttons: 🌅 Morning, 🧑‍💻 Work block, 🌇 End of day, 🌙 Bedtime.

steps.do: Tap “🌅 Morning”.
steps.see: Morning now has a ✓ after it, and a “Next →” button appears underneath.

steps.do: Tap “Next →”.
steps.see: “SETTING UP · 2 OF 4” — “Now, something that repeats on a day.” with “Add one →” and “Nothing repeats — skip”.

steps.do: Tap “Nothing repeats — skip”.
steps.see: “SETTING UP · 3 OF 4” — “Anything coming up on a date?”

steps.do: Tap “Nothing yet — skip”.
steps.see: “SETTING UP · 4 OF 4” asks for the one thing on your mind. Below it, TODAY'S LIST already has your morning steps: “Water + meds”, “Look at today (2 min, no phone)” and “One hard thing first”, then “▾ 1 more waiting”.

steps.do: Scroll down a little to the box that says “add to the river…”. Leave it empty and tap the orange “Add” button.
steps.see: Nothing happens: no blank task is added and the line still says “▾ 1 more waiting”.

steps.do: Tap the “add to the river…” box, type the task below, then tap the orange “Add”.
steps.see: The box empties and the line above it now says “▾ 2 more waiting — tap when you're ready” (your new task is tucked at the end of the list).

steps.do: Scroll back up and tap “I’ve typed it — done ✓”.
steps.see: A big ✓ and “Your day is set.” with a “Show me my one thing →” button.

steps.do: Tap “Show me my one thing →”. (If a card first says “These didn't get their turn yesterday”, tap “Not today — park them in the Brain Dump”: that card only comes when you test across two days.)
steps.see: A big card says “NOW — JUST THIS ONE: Water + meds” with a 2:00 timer and a big green “✓ Done!” button. Scroll down a little: a greeting line under the card includes your name, Margaret O'Brien.

steps.do: Tap “✓ Done!”.
steps.see: The NOW card moves on to “Look at today (2 min, no phone)”. Further down the list, “✓ Done today (1)” shows Water + meds ticked and crossed out.
steps.tip: The “🏁 Finish setup” pill and the round “?” button sit over the corners of the Done button — tap the middle of it.

steps.do: Scroll down to TODAY'S LIST and tap “▾ 1 more waiting — tap when you're ready”.
steps.see: The list opens up: “Call Pastor Dan” is at the bottom, with “▴ tuck the rest away” under it.

steps.do: Tap the words “Call Pastor Dan” (not the little box in front of it).
steps.see: Call Pastor Dan jumps to the top of TODAY'S LIST. Scroll up: the NOW card now says “Call Pastor Dan” with a 25:00 timer.
steps.tip: Tapping the little square box instead ticks it done; if that happens, tap the box again to un-tick it.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Nothing is lost: the NOW card still says “Call Pastor Dan”, “✓ Done today (1)” is still there, and the greeting still has Margaret O'Brien.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then type this in the “add to the river…” box and tap “Add”:
steps.see: A yellow strip at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” Tap “▾ … more waiting” and “Bake Grandma's pie” is in the list, apostrophe and all.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off again, then scroll back to the top of the screen.
steps.see: The NOW card is still “Call Pastor Dan” with its 25:00 timer, and the greeting line still says Margaret O'Brien. You set up a whole morning, finished one thing, and picked your next one.
